scope: Written mathematical deduction and independent prose review only; unsigned PCC standing; no native run or asymptotic relation-solving claim.
statement: For a supplied nonsingular odd-order E/Fp, prime p>=4096 and power-of-two4<=q<=sqrt(p)/16 with4q dividingp+1, the written genus-one/genus-two count proves at least one sixth of regular split q-point Dickson fibres have B>=q/4. The exact uniform-torus sampler takes fewer than7 expected seeds and O(q log p) ordinary field-operation setup plus inversions and O(q) storage. Capping the reviewed Linnik family retains q=Omega(p^(1/L)). This constructs a base on the same supplied curve; it does not construct a prime-order family or solve a target.
